## Education

## Administrative leadership

**Assistant Director for Undergraduate Studies**, Department of Mathematics, NYU, 2023–2025

- One of two positions created from the Vice Chair role. Primary focus on the
  introductory division of the undergraduate program.

**Vice Chair for Undergraduate Affairs**, Department of Mathematics, NYU, 2008–2023

- Directed the service-level mathematics program, which teaches 7,000 students
  each academic year in calculus, precalculus, discrete mathematics,
  quantitative reasoning, and linear algebra.
- Developed a common syllabus for Calculus I, II, and III and instituted a
  course coordination system to normalize academic content and policies.
- Managed and led a team of 12 clinical faculty members.
- Directed training of novice teachers, including graduate teaching assistants,
  postdoctoral lecturers, and undergraduate tutors and graders.
- Managed student affairs issues including honors, credit transfers, graduation
  requirements, academic integrity violations, and other sensitive student issues.
- Managed learning outcomes assessment of service-level courses.

**Course Head**, Harvard University, 2003–2008

- Led courses across the calculus sequence: chose texts, set syllabi, managed
  section leaders, wrote exams, and assigned final grades.
